text: My opinion is that social media is helpful because it lets people stay connected and helps teenagers get access to information about mental health.

atoms.instruction: Read and highlight the sentence that supports Noor’s opinion.

atoms.a: Why does the author say social media helps people stay connected?
b: ++because people can communicate quickly even from far away
because people only use phones for entertainment
because social media is about professional networking
because social media replaces real communication

atoms.a: How do people use their phones today?
b: ++They use them for many different daily activities.
They use them mostly for online games.
They only use them to communicate.
They mainly use them for work and university.
++right away
after a long time
only on special days
from far away

atoms.instruction: Read and highlight the evidence that supports Noor’s opinion.

atoms.a: What do the numbers in the paragraph show about how teenagers use social media?
b: ++Many teenagers use it to stay connected with people.
Most teenagers use it only for games and entertainment.
Very few teenagers find it useful for communication.
Not many teenagers use social media these days.

atoms.a: What can we understand about social media based on this study?
b: ++It helps teenagers maintain relationships.
It replaces all face-to-face communication.
It is mostly used for entertainment.
It is not very important for teenagers.
++in a successful way
very slowly
without planning
in a strange way

atoms.instruction: Read and highlight the evidence that supports Noor’s opinion.

atoms.a: Why might social media be helpful during difficult times?
b: ++It allows teenagers to receive support from others.
It replaces all face-to-face support teenagers need.
It prevents teenagers from feeling emotions.
It allows teenagers to be distracted with videos.

atoms.a: What do the survey results suggest about teenagers’ experiences online?
b: ++A lot of teenagers feel emotionally supported through social media.
Most teenagers avoid using social media when they are stressed.
All teenagers only feel emotionally supported through social media.
No one feels emotionally supported through social media.

atoms.a: What does the word isolated most likely mean?
b: ++feeling alone or separated from others
feeling excited and energetic
being busy with schoolwork
feeling sick or not in a good mood
